name: Tinkers Ascent
detailed_description:
Jump to new heights in Tinkers Ascent, a 3D platformer adventure game. Collect, craft, and rebuild in this world of floating islands. The biggest thing to remember: don't look down... or maybe just don't fall down.

Platforming

Jump, dive, dash, and slide around a world of floating islands in the sky. Explore deep caves, climb up to the highest mountain, and explore down to the abandoned sea islands.

Gathering

Search the world for wood, stone, ore, and other useful materials to add to your inventory. Equipped with tools like your trusty axe to chop down trees, or go mining with a handcrafted pickaxe, there are tons of ways to find the resources you need.

Crafting

Craft—or Tinker—with materials you've gathered to create building pieces, new tools, and more supplies for the people in Tinkers Ascent. Learn your craft, learn new recipes, and make use of all the different crafting stations: from sawmills to furnaces, and everything else you'd need. 

Building

After a disaster strikes, your job is to help rebuild the towns that live on the floating islands in Tinkers Ascent. Use the materials you've gathered and crafted to put things back in order, unlocking new features and areas along the way.

Quests

Experience a variety of quests that help you discover the world in Tinkers Ascent. Learn about the interesting NPCs as you help them with both big jobs and little ones, too.
